children: VisionWave entered into a binding purchase order to supply 200 STRATUM VARAN heavy wheeled unmanned ground vehicles to Metal Machinery Components Trading for an aggregate base price of $20 million. The order requires a 10% advance payment backed by a bank guarantee and is subject to proof of funds, export licenses, compliance reviews, and end-user approvals. Deliveries are planned in three batches over up to 36 months after the Effective Date, which has not yet occurred. The base price excludes payloads, weapon stations, mission systems, upgrades, spares, taxes, and logistics, which would require separate orders.
